bullets: On Wednesday 28 October, DLD recorded 484 sales worth AED 1.3bn, which is 2.9% below a typical weekday.
Off-plan properties made up 63.6% of sales, compared to a 7-day average of 60.7%.
The median price was AED 1,664 per square foot, flat on the 30-day median and down 0.2% from last year.
Over the last seven days, the busiest areas for sales were JVC with 220 sales, Dubai South with 196 sales, and Business Bay with 121 sales.
In September new rental contracts, a JVC 1-bedroom apartment had a median rent of AED 69,000 a year, up 3.2% on the month.
talking_points: Standard Asset Company has launched a $1.5 billion crypto and property strategy, which introduces significant alternative capital into the property sector.
Dubai rental contracts can now be annulled before starting if deception is proven, clarifying legal rights for tenants and landlords regarding fraudulent leases.
Abu Dhabi apartment prices surged 24 percent in Q3 2026, providing critical valuation metrics for the capital's residential sector.
